causes.title: What Causes Wisdom Tooth Pain?
causes.intro: Wisdom teeth are the last set of molars to erupt, usually between the ages of 17 and 25. In many cases, there isn't enough space in the jaw for these teeth to emerge properly, leading to pain, swelling, and infection.
items: Food trapping around partially erupted teeth
causes.footer: Prompt treatment helps relieve pain and prevents future complications.

items.question: How do I know if my wisdom tooth needs treatment?
items.answer: Persistent pain, swelling, jaw stiffness, difficulty chewing, or repeated infections may indicate that your wisdom tooth requires professional evaluation.

items.question: Is wisdom tooth removal painful?
items.answer: No. The procedure is performed under local anesthesia, making the treatment comfortable. Mild soreness afterward is normal and usually resolves within a few days.

items.question: When should a wisdom tooth be removed?
items.answer: Removal is recommended when the tooth is impacted, infected, causing pain, damaging nearby teeth, or leading to recurring gum problems.

items.question: How long does recovery take after wisdom tooth removal?
items.answer: Most patients recover within a few days, while complete healing generally occurs over the following weeks depending on the complexity of the procedure.

items.question: What is the cost of wisdom tooth treatment in Pune?
items.answer: The cost depends on the position of the tooth, whether it is impacted, and whether surgical extraction is required. A consultation allows us to provide an accurate estimate.

items.question: Can wisdom tooth pain go away without treatment?
items.answer: Temporary relief is possible, but the underlying issue often remains. Delaying treatment may increase the risk of infection, swelling, and damage to nearby teeth.
